description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

In this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game development and virtual creations. The presentations covered practical tips for designing game character clothing, as well as a special explanation of how Marvelous Designer interacts with Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual clothing, from the mutual growth between Marvelous Designer and its users to the shocking release of new features in 2025.

Don't miss out on these exciting contents!

I don't know how to write well; my presentation will mainly be based on demonstration, so it might be a little hard. This is my self-introduction: last year, I came back from Tangping and stayed at home for a while. I have been in this industry for 20 years, working with various companies. I have participated in some movie projects and have an interest in A-Zhang. I don't have a lot of personal things to share, just some experiences that have flowed through my career. --- ## Sharing Marvelous Designer Skills Today, I would like to share some of my skills in Marvelous Designer (MD). I have been using MD since 2010, as one of the earliest users in Beiji Guang via Tangxun. I first utilized it in Tianyang Mingrui Dao. I will discuss some character designs I worked on in previous projects and some skills I have learned along the way. ### Early Preparation The initial preparation for game production is significant. I am unsure if there are game developers or fashion designers in the audience today, but I believe that game design differs from clothing design. In game production, we must consider the process of use rather than just the final product. Many people who create with MD often focus on new designs without considering the foundational elements. I often look for old references in the early stages of design. In game production, we need to consider external factors and potential issues that may arise during the development process. --- ## Utilizing Marvelous Designer Resources Currently, Marvelous Designer offers official materials called Connect, which include a variety of free resources, such as basic T-shirts and hats. I enjoy starting with a basic pair of pants and progressively adding complexity. Many people I see in classes tend to focus on minute details at the beginning, which can make the process more challenging. ### Game Design Principles In terms of game design, the hobby requires a lot of outlines and details. I personally enjoy working in MD, as I prefer to define shapes and structures from the start. Many designers focus on large elements; however, I believe adding detailed lines and features early on can enhance the overall design. For example, I often use a double-layer concept, which allows for more intricate designs. --- ## Technical Aspects and Tips ### Internal Lines and Shape Control When working on designs, I frequently add internal lines to control the shape of the garments. This technique allows for more precise control over folds and shapes. By adding numerous internal lines, I can manipulate the garment's appearance to achieve a more dynamic look. This method is particularly effective for creating garments like cuirasses, where I can control various movements and shapes. In game design, unlike costume design or film, we need real-time control over character movements. ### Enhancing Garment Realism Furthermore, I focus on the details of clothing, such as edges and wrinkles. For instance, when creating pants, I consider small features and edges, which contribute significantly to the overall appearance. Using techniques from MD, I can ensure that the clothing remains visually appealing in screenshots and animations. I also emphasize the importance of memory marks in designs. Adding these details can help garments appear more lifelike and responsive to movements. --- ## Advanced Techniques ### Using Internal Lines for Effects I often use internal lines to create interesting effects and simulate specific features. By adjusting angles and strengths, I can produce a variety of results. This approach allows for more creativity in garment design. ### Final Adjustments and Resolution As I finalize designs, I focus on adjusting resolutions and adding inner lines to control movements. With the latest version of MD, I can achieve perfect results by carefully managing these details. --- ## Conclusion Thank you for your attention. This presentation covered various technical aspects and personal insights into using Marvelous Designer in game production. Are there any questions? --- ## Q&A Session **Question:** Is it better to adjust internal lines for water-based fabrics to achieve better wrinkle effects? **Answer:** Yes, adjusting internal lines can help, but it’s essential to reference real-life examples to achieve realistic results. Wrinkles should be handled carefully, as excessive detail can detract from the overall quality. **Question:** Do you use Marvelous Designer in game design? **Answer:** Absolutely. While the final design needs to be calculated carefully for games, I apply the same principles used in film and animation, ensuring that character models accurately reflect their intended movements. --- Thank you once again for your interest, and feel free to reach out with any further questions! ```
